prompt_text: Who is the best HVAC company in Houston for AC repair?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single universally “best” HVAC company for AC repair in Houston — the right choice depends on your location, the problem, your budget, and whether you need emergency service. That said, here’s a practical way to find a top provider plus a few reputable names that serve the area.

Reputable companies that serve Houston
- John Moore — long-established Houston-based HVAC/plumbing/roofing company with good local name recognition.
- ARS/Rescue Rooter — national firm with local branches and 24/7 service.
- One Hour Heating & Air Conditioning / On Time Service — franchised HVAC companies with local teams and emergency availability.
- Aire Serv — national HVAC franchise with local contractors.

(There are many excellent independent local shops too — some smaller companies have outstanding reviews and quicker response times. I can look up top-rated local contractors for your ZIP if you want.)

How to choose the best company for your situation
- Licensing: Verify the techs are licensed by the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR).  
- Certifications: Look for NATE-certified technicians and factory-authorized dealer status for your AC brand.  
- Insurance & warranties: Confirm liability insurance and ask about parts/labor warranties.  
- Reviews & complaints: Check Google, Yelp, Angi/HomeAdvisor, and the BBB for reviews and complaint history.  
- Get multiple quotes: Get at least 2 written estimates, including diagnostic fees and parts/labor breakdown.  
- Ask questions: How long to repair, estimated lifespan if you repair vs replace, permit requirements, and emergency fees.  
- Red flags: High-pressure sales, no diagnostic, “must pay full up front,” very low bids with no detail.

Typical questions to ask a technician on the phone
- Are you licensed and insured? Can you provide your license number?  
- Are your techs NATE-certified or factory-trained for my brand?  
- Do you offer same-day or emergency service? What are the extra fees?  
- What is your diagnostic fee and is it applied to the repair?  
- What warranties do you provide on parts and labor?

If you want, tell me your ZIP code and a brief description of the problem (noisy unit, not cooling, leaks, etc.) and I’ll pull up highly-rated local options and typical cost ranges for that repair.
